candidates.name: Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia
support_spans: Bronchoalveolar lavage (BAL) fluid was positive for Pneumocystis jirovecii on Grocott’s methenamine silver stain
contradict_spans: Repeat BAL was negative for AFB, fungus, and Pneumocystis jirovecii
candidates.why: The patient's initial symptoms and laboratory findings, including bilateral diffuse alveolar infiltrates and positive BAL fluid for Pneumocystis jirovecii, are consistent with Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia.

candidates.name: Immune reconstitution inflammatory syndrome (IRIS)
support_spans: He was treated with trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole and a prednisone taper, with clinical and radiographic resolution of infiltrates after 2 weeks
Three weeks into therapy, he was asymptomatic except for an occasional dry cough
Repeat HRCT showed resolution of ground-glass opacities and new patchy peribronchovascular consolidations in the right upper lobe, left upper lobe, and left lower-lobe apical segment
candidates.why: The patient's clinical and radiographic improvement after treatment, followed by the development of new symptoms and radiographic findings after discontinuation of TMP-SMX, are consistent with IRIS.

candidates.name: Organizing pneumonia
support_spans: Transbronchial lung biopsy from the left upper lobe showed alveoli filled with inflammatory debris consisting of granulation tissue, interstitial inflammation, and areas of intra-alveolar fibrin deposition
candidates.why: The patient's lung biopsy findings, including granulation tissue and intra-alveolar fibrin deposition, are consistent with organizing pneumonia.
